reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the fluorine effect, which is well-established for TiAl alloys (P1, P6, P15, P21), to a refractory high-entropy alloy system. The mechanism is taken word for word from the TiAl literature, and the predicted outcome mirrors the TiAl results. The experimental conditions (1100 °C, 200 h, TGA) are copied from the RHEA oxidation study (P2, P8). The core idea is simply applying a known treatment to a different alloy class without any new mechanistic insight or justification for why it should work in the complex multicomponent RHEA matrix, which the hypothesis itself acknowledges is uncertain.
